description: A reddish chalk ground with water into a thick paste and brushed over an edge before gilding. It fills minor irregularities and gives a smooth even ground that helps the gold lie flat and burnish to a solid colour.
name: gilder's red chalk

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1901), Chapter VI, p.96. Internet Archive.
